import React, { useEffect, useRef } from "react"; import gsap from "gsap"; import { ScrollTrigger } from "gsap/ScrollTrigger"; gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger); const ProductAndServices = () => { const cardsRef = useRef([]); useEffect(() => { gsap.utils.toArray(cardsRef.current).forEach((card, i) => { gsap.set(card, { opacity: 0 }); // Ensure each card starts hidden ScrollTrigger.create({ trigger: card, start: "top 80%", // Trigger when the top of the card hits 80% of the viewport end: "bottom 20%", // End when the bottom of the card hits 20% of the viewport scrub: true, onEnter: () => gsap.to(card, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.5 }), onLeave: () => gsap.to(card, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.5 }), onEnterBack: () => gsap.to(card, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.5 }), onLeaveBack: () => gsap.to(card, { opacity: 1, duration: 0.5 }), }); }); }, []); return (

PRODUCTS & SERVICES

{/* First Card */}
(cardsRef.current[0] = el)} className="card sticky top-0">
MATCH GRAPHICS

Our Match Graphics service is designed to bring real-time, data-driven visuals to your live sports broadcasts, enhancing the viewing experience and keeping audiences engaged. We specialize in creating dynamic and customizable graphics that display critical game information such as scores, player statistics, team lineups, and in-depth analysis. Our solutions are fully adaptable to your brand’s style, ensuring seamless integration into live coverage, from pre-game shows to post-match analysis, delivering a professional and polished presentation every time.

{/* Second Card */}
(cardsRef.current[1] = el)} className="card sticky top-0">
AUGMENTED REALITY GRAPHICS

With Augmented Reality (AR) Graphics, we take sports broadcasting to the next level by blending real-world footage with digital enhancements. Our AR graphics create immersive experiences that engage viewers, providing visual layers such as interactive scoreboards, player stats, virtual commentary panels, and more, all overlaid onto the live broadcast. Whether it's a highlight reel or a live moment, AR graphics add depth and interactivity, helping broadcasters captivate audiences and offer a cutting-edge viewing experience that truly stands out from the competition.

{/* Third Card */}
(cardsRef.current[2] = el)} className="card sticky top-0">
VIRTUAL REALITY GRAPHICS

Our Virtual Reality (VR) Graphics services offer an entirely new way for fans to experience live sports. Through fully immersive 3D environments, viewers can explore different aspects of the game in real-time. From navigating through player stats to replaying game highlights, our VR graphics transform a traditional broadcast into an interactive experience where the audience feels like they are part of the action. By creating lifelike visual environments, we make it possible for broadcasters to deliver a next-generation experience that keeps fans engaged and returning for more.

{/* First Card */}
(cardsRef.current[3] = el)} className="card sticky top-0">
THIRD PARTY INTEGRATIONS

In today’s fast-paced world of broadcasting, having access to live data and external content is essential. Our Third Party Integration services allow seamless connection between your broadcast graphics and external data sources, such as live sports statistics, social media feeds, betting platforms, or any other third-party API. We ensure that all incoming data is efficiently displayed through our graphics systems, offering viewers dynamic and up-to-date information. This integration not only enriches the content but also provides broadcasters with an edge in delivering the most relevant, real-time data to their audiences.

{/* Second Card */}
(cardsRef.current[4] = el)} className="card sticky top-0">
LIVE ENGAGEMENT ANALYTICS (LEA)

LEA, which seamlessly integrates tracking data from third-party applications across various sports with broadcast visuals to enhance storytelling. This innovation provides our clients with a distinct advantage, enabling them to easily onboard third-party clients for data integration into the broadcast graphics package.

{/* Third Card */}
(cardsRef.current[5] = el)} className="card sticky top-0">
SPONSOR INTEGRATIONS

Our Sponsor Integration service for Virtual Reality broadcasts provides a unique opportunity for advertisers and sponsors to gain prime visibility in immersive environments. By embedding branded content, logos, and interactive ads directly within the VR experience, we help ensure that sponsor messaging is an integral part of the broadcast without interrupting the viewer’s experience. These integrations can be strategically placed to align with the action, whether on virtual banners, player gear, or even in virtual stadiums. This approach maximizes brand exposure, creating a lasting impact and enhancing the overall value proposition for sponsors.

); }; export default ProductAndServices;
